result.title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error
result.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures; code and data in ancillary files
result.summary: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 agent 任务中途冻结世界状态，分别编辑历史或世界：在 AgentCE-Bench 中用「真实注记」与「已完成动作」两种方式补入正确值，在 AppWorld 中操控数据库写入回执与副作用是否存在，再让接收模型续做，考察恢复率与整任务成功率如何随表述形式与世界状态变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「上下文声称已修正、而世界仍留错误时反而更差」的发现，与 LVR 中内部状态是否忠实反映视觉证据、正确信息能否真正被使用可供核查；或可启发对 latent/历史内容与外部证据一致性及状态忠实性的评价设计。
